header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.tamil_translation: is deprived of provision due to him because of a sin,” narrates Hazrat Thawban (RA) that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- It has come in a hadith that if this person makes Du'a to Allah Ta'ala, then that too — his “making Du'a — has been decreed with Allah Ta'ala.” Likewise, the meaning of the above hadith is that if a person's age is sixty years, it will also have been decided with Allah Ta'ala that because of some good deed he does (for example) performing Hajj, twenty years will be added to his life and he will live for eighty years.
(Mirqat)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَاعَلَي اْلاَرْضِ مُسْلِمٌ يَدْعُو اللهَ تَعَالَي بِدَعْوَةٍ إِلَّا آتَاهُ اللهُ إِيَّاهَا أَوْ صَرَفَ عَنْهُ مِنَ السُّوءِ مِثْلَهَا مَالَمْ يَدْعُ بِمَاْثَمٍ أَوْ قَطِيعَةِ رَحِمٍ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ: إِذاً نُكْثِرُ قَالَ: اَللهُ أَكْثَرُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقَالَ: هذا حديث غريب صحيح باب انتظار الفرج وغير ذلك رقم:٣٥٧٣. ورواه الحاكم وزاد فيه: أَوْ يَدَّخِرُلَهُ مِنَ اْلاَجْرِ مِثْلَهَا. وقَالَ: هذا حديث صحيح الاسناد ووافقه الذهبي:١ /٤٩٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ubadah ibn Samit (RA) narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ said, “Whenever any Muslim on earth makes Du'a to Allah Ta'ala for things that are not sinful and do not involve severing ties of kinship, Allah Ta'ala either gives him exactly what he asked for, or by that Du'a removes from him a hardship that was coming to him to the extent of his Du'a, or stores up for him a reward equal to his Du'a,” a man said, “In that case (if Du'a is certainly accepted, or something is received in its place) we shall make Du'a a great deal!” Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Allah Ta'ala too gives a great deal more.”
